page.title: Pricing rules
page.desc: Deterministic WHEN → THEN rules that generate or guard price changes. Higher-priority rules win when proposals conflict on the same SKU.

scope.allWhenEmpty: Leave empty to apply to all

when.title: When (all conditions must hold)
when.hint: All values are numeric — percent, units, days, or price.

then.title: Then
then.kind.min_margin_pct: Set price to reach min margin %

builder.previewEmpty: No current SKUs match these conditions.

run.none: Rule run finished: no SKUs matched
run.conflict: {n} skipped: higher-priority rule already covers the SKU

conflict.title: Priority conflicts
conflict.desc: Multiple active rules target these SKUs — only the highest-priority rule will fire on each run:

err.forbidden: Your role cannot manage or run rules.
err.conflict: This rule was edited elsewhere — reload to see the latest version, or overwrite it.

empty: No pricing rules yet. Create one to automate price proposals.
note: Rules are deterministic and auditable — every generated recommendation links back to the rule that produced it.

editConflict.title: Edited elsewhere
editConflict.desc: This rule changed since you opened it. Reload to discard your edits, or overwrite the other version.

discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.desc: Your edits to this rule haven't been saved.
